author: masonmylespro
text:
RIP to Andy Williams. An incredible human being, who at one point, played the soundtrack to my every day life. He used his talents to entertain millions and in doing so was met with the love he deserved. 

A true legend never to be forgotten.

author: TheJohnSkyler
text:
To know Andy Williams was a real treat. 

Kind hearted. Always made you laugh….even if it meant laughing at himself. 

He will be incredibly missed by all. 

My heart, thoughts, and prayers go out to his loved ones. 💔💔

author: VoxWayaOfficial
text:

I really don't want to comment on this without confirmation tho, because it's kinda hard for me to believe right now.
